# P1 Git Commits — verify git commit messages for each operation

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Commit Note
summary: Test git commit
tags: test
---
Note content.
-- note-input.md --

-- append-input.md --
Appended line.
-- append-input.md --

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Commit ADR
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Test ADR commit
tags: test
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-01-01'
---
ADR content.
-- adr-input.md --

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# --- Write creates a git commit ---
exec akb write commit-note.md <../note-input.md

# Verify write commit message
exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: write kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# --- Append creates a git commit ---
exec akb append notes/commit-note.md <../append-input.md

# Verify append commit message
exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: append kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# --- Delete creates a git commit ---
exec akb delete notes/commit-note.md

# Verify delete commit message
exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: delete kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# --- Verify commit history has all three operations ---
exec git log --oneline
stdout 'akb: delete kb/notes/commit-note.md'
stdout 'akb: append kb/notes/commit-note.md'
stdout 'akb: write kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# --- Write an ADR and verify its commit message ---
exec akb write commit-adr.md <../adr-input.md

exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: write kb/decisions/commit-adr.md'
